create_rule: create a SARIF diagnostic Rule with an id, name, message template, and optional descriptions
build_rule_collection: build a custom RuleCollection class dynamically from a list of Rule instances
test_rule_format: test the Rule.format method to produce a (rule, level, message) tuple for diagnostics
review_rule_from_sarif: review parsing a Rule from SARIF reporting descriptor kwargs via Rule.from_sarif
summarize_diagnostic_options: summarize DiagnosticOptions for setting verbosity level and treating warnings as errors
